risk_discussion: The proposed allocation balances the Fidelity Q2 2026 ratings with the common market volatility diagnostics. Information Technology (45) carries the highest weight (37%) due to its strong fundamentals and post-decline valuation, despite a daily volatility of 0.0113. Conversely, sectors like Energy (10) and Materials (15) are kept low due to unfavorable risk-return profiles and capital spending concerns. The allocation assumes that historical volatility is a diagnostic tool rather than a guarantee of future risk, and that the S&P 500 sector reference serves as a neutral benchmark rather than a target. No departures from source preferences were made as the initial allocation already satisfied the sum-to-one constraint.
